edition.notes: The notice is displayed under VACATIO LEGIS within the exact Latin Orientalium Ecclesiarum HTML response, before that delivery's abridged subscription block. It has no separately owned web artifact because the exact response belongs to the Decree's dated delivery state; the authoritative Acta constituent is modeled separately.
edition.publication: Notice co-delivered in the Holy See Latin web presentation of Orientalium Ecclesiarum, retrieved 2026-07-24
edition.title: Vacatio legis notice concerning Orientalium Ecclesiarum — Vatican Latin web state

alternate_titles: Notification concerning the vacatio legis of the Decree on the Catholic Eastern Churches
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The separately titled notification recording Pope Paul VI's decision that Orientalium Ecclesiarum have a two-month vacatio legis, while allowing patriarchs for a just cause to reduce or extend that period.
work.title: Notificatio concerning Orientalium Ecclesiarum
